description: ASTRA: Automated Simulation of TRAnsportation networks for SUMO is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Qiongdan HU. ASTRA supports SUMO network construction, demand calibration, simulation, and result review. It provides four topic skills, command-line tools, and optional local MCP tools. Version 1.3.1 corrects citation metadata and enables Zenodo archiving. Traffic models and simulation behavior are unchanged from ASTRA 1.3.0. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
